verdict.rationale: Synthesia's own marketing names a built-in "AI Assistant" that turns a prompt, link, or file into a finished video, so users can hand off video drafting to an in-product assistant. That is the only documented delegation, and it rests on brief marketing copy. The MCP integration (external AI tools calling Synthesia) and the Interactive Avatars agents (for end viewers) are different capabilities and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what the assistant can do beyond generating a video, conversational or multi-step task delegation inside the editor, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Turn any prompt, link, or file into a polished video with helpful AI Assistant.
Write a prompt and add context. Get a finished video.
